name: model-bench-web
description: Node/Vercel side of model-bench: the Cost Meter shared module (W-M1/W-M2), and the model-bench use-case page + its own functions (W-A3/W-A4). Python never deploys here (BUILD INSTRUCTION rule 9). The Cost Meter module (api/meter/*) stays zero-runtime-dependency by design so a Vercel cold start has nothing to install for it; api/run-one.js is the one exception (D18 in CONTEXT.md) -- it needs @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime to call Bedrock's Converse API, the same tradeoff Python's D10 already made for boto3 (hand-rolling AWS SigV4 signing is not worth it for a fallback-free primary path).
